svg.text: The path the system follows, from a user's sentence to a closed record

g.text: User describes the issue in free text
support group, impact, priority and its rationale
each step shows its source and past success rate
with attempted steps and chat history
match score plus the reason they are similar
generated per ticket, not a fixed list
Fed back into the knowledge base

svg.text: the system learns as it is used

g.text: drag and drop, paste or browse
in-browser for Word and PDF, AI for images
edit, delete, add — no tests without approval
every test links to a requirement: REQ-03 → TEST-07
Passed / Failed / Not applicable + evidence file

svg.text: No step above depends entirely on an external service. When one fails, the system does not error out — it falls back to a simpler layer.
2 retries → 3 fallback models → local keyword matching
switches to 4-second polling after 6 seconds, shown in the status dot
user is informed, the flow continues with text
